reserveReview.rationale: Live adapter remeasurement on 2026-09-09 at Optimism block 156691711 and Base block 51096426, both timestamp 1788982199. DepositManager aOptUSDT and aBasUSDC balances are valued with live DefiLlama underlying USDT/USDC prices, producing 87.7% USDT and 12.3% USDC. UNDERLYING_ASSET_ADDRESS() was verified on both Aave receipts: Optimism USDT 0x94b008aa00579c1307b0ef2c499ad98a8ce58e58 and Base USDC 0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913, both six decimals. aToken balanceOf already includes accrued interest in 1:1 underlying units; no Compound-style conversion applies. Both chain holdings are included. Aave utilization-driven withdrawal latency and legal custody terms remain separate from these measured weights.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: On-chain aToken balances of DePhaser DepositManager proxies plus issuer money-flow docs
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Legal segregation/bankruptcy-remoteness of Aave positions and instantaneous redeemable liquidity under high Aave utilization are not published as static legal terms; weights themselves are measured.
